title: key-person-risk-hub-hero
subject: A printed organisational chart on a wooden meeting table where all connection lines converge on one highlighted person card in amber, with a hand placing a second card beside it — symbolising identifying the single point of failure and building redundancy.
context: Beraterium blog hero for the cross-persona hub article on key person risk: what it is, how it differs for SMEs, startups and solo self-employed, and which immediate measures reduce it. Theme: one person carrying too many unique functions, and the calm structured act of de-risking it. Warm, professional B2B editorial, constructive, not alarmist.

platform_website.optimized_variants: Build creates schluesselpersonrisiko-erkennen-absichern-hero.webp plus -480w, -960w, -1440w responsive WebP from the PNG source
platform_website.best_practice_notes: Wide 16:9 hero; the org chart with one amber-highlighted node is the visual story; generous negative space in upper third; readable at thumbnail and full width.
platform_website.safe_zone: Keep the highlighted node in central 90% width; avoid critical detail in extreme left/right 5% and bottom 10%.

composition.shot_type: top-down to slightly angled tabletop shot
composition.depth: foreground printed org chart with abstract person cards connected by lines, one card highlighted in amber where most lines converge, a hand placing a second blank card next to it; background softly blurred meeting table with coffee cups and a notebook

style.mood: analytical, constructive, calm — spotting the dependency and fixing it

ai_disclosure.placement: small legible label in the bottom-right corner of the image; never alt-text only
ai_disclosure.prompt_instruction: Small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in the bottom-right corner: small clean sans-serif, white at ~70% opacity, unobtrusive but readable.

optional_text_overlay.typography: Prefer no text on image — article H1 renders above hero.
optional_text_overlay.prompt_instruction: No readable names or text on the chart; abstract person icons and connection lines only, one node highlighted in amber.

negative_prompt: no watermarks or text except the small AI-disclosure label bottom right
no readable text or names on the chart (only exception: the small AI-disclosure label bottom right)
no red alarm icons or broken-chain clichés
no identifiable real persons or celebrities

seo.alt_text: Organigramm auf einem Tisch mit einer hervorgehobenen Schlüsselperson, um die sich alle Verbindungen bündeln
seo.caption: Schlüsselpersonrisiko erkennen: Wo alle Verbindungen an einer Person hängen, entsteht ein Single Point of Failure.

generation_prompt_single_block_en: Landscape editorial photograph 1920x1080, 16:9, high angle about 45 degrees over a wooden meeting table, navy charcoal tones (#1F2A44) with cyan (#00A3FF) and amber (#F2B134) accents. Foreground: a printed organisational chart with abstract person cards connected by clean lines, most lines converging on one card highlighted in amber (no readable names or text, abstract person icons only). A well-groomed hand places a second blank card next to the highlighted one, symbolising building redundancy. Background: softly blurred meeting table with coffee cup and notebook. Soft warm daylight from top left, medium-low contrast, analytical constructive mood — spotting a dependency and fixing it calmly. Generous negative space upper third for blog header. Clean editorial realism, medium-high detail. In the bottom-right corner add a small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in a small clean sans-serif, white at about 70% opacity — unobtrusive but readable at full width and thumbnail size. No other readable text, no watermarks, no third-party logos, no broken-chain or alarm clichés, no hospital imagery, no distorted hands. Safe zone: highlighted node central 90% width.
